name: White House
description: Follow White House, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump encourages Darline Graham to run for Lindsey Graham's seat
changes.summary: Darline Graham indicated in a White House meeting Thursday that she's weighing a bid, CBS News confirmed. A day later, President Trump wrote on Truth Social: "RUN, DARLINE, RUN! ".

changes.title: Trump says these documents prove his false claims of election fraud. Here's what they really say
changes.summary: "The White House promised a bombshell, and they delivered a dud," said David Becker, executive director of the Center for Election Innovation & Research.

changes.title: Trump Brings Full Weight of Government to Bolster False Election Claims
changes.summary: Intelligence agencies provided the White House with a trove of declassified documents that President Trump cited on Thursday as evidence of election vulnerabilities.

changes.title: White House teleprompter operator allegedly made over $100K betting on Trump's speeches
changes.summary: The prediction market Kalshi alleges President Trump's longtime teleprompter operator engaged in trading, betting on the words the president would use in speeches. Jo Ling Kent reports.

changes.title: Trump administration to declassify documents relating to China and U.S. elections
changes.summary: President Donald Trump addressed the nation from the White House, announcing that the administration will declassify documents related to the 2020 election and alleged influence by China.

changes.title: Trump Has Dismantled Election Security Efforts. Here’s How.
changes.summary: Since his return to the White House, the lead federal partner for states on election security has lost around a third of its work force.

changes.title: Fact checking Trump speech on election security
changes.summary: President Trump is delivering a speech on election security Thursday night at the White House.

changes.title: How paper ballots make digital manipulation of results unlikely
changes.summary: NBC News’ Jane Timm analyzes President Trump’s claims about digital manipulation of ballot results in the U.S., as Trump said that the White House will declassify documents related to the 2020 election and alleged influence by China during his speech to the nation.
